items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Louie Bonfa, all of them. [INTERVIEWEE] Luiz Bonfa.

ctx.x: So it’s a smile and a tear right there. With one chord. And Brazilian music full of that—Jobim and…
Luiz Bonfa. Ivan Lins is a great favorite of mine. And we’ll do some concerts later in October.
